$comment: Single source of truth for MCP servers. scripts/lib/mcp-sync.mjs translates each entry into every agent's own config format. tier=core installs by default; tier=extra installs with --mcp extra (or --mcp all). Entries are only ever ADDED — an existing server with the same name is never overwritten.

shadcn.description: Browse, search and install shadcn/ui registry components

chrome-devtools.description: Performance traces, console, network and DOM debugging

next-devtools.description: Live errors, routes and logs from a running Next.js 16+ dev server

deepwiki.description: Ask questions about any public GitHub repo's architecture

excalidraw.description: Hand-drawn architecture / flow diagrams (needs an MCP-Apps capable client)

figma.description: Design-to-code context from Figma (OAuth on first use)

sentry.description: Pull production errors and traces into the agent (OAuth on first use)

appmap.description: Runtime API -> function -> SQL flow queries (needs AppMap CLI + recorded app)
